response.sql:
WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    AVG(ili.product_price) AS item_avg_price,
    AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS item_avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
), town_averages AS (
  SELECT
    town_city,
    AVG(item_avg_price) AS average_price,
    AVG(item_avg_ratio) AS average_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town_city
), with_cross_town_average AS (
  SELECT
    town_city,
    average_price,
    average_ratio,
    AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS cross_town_average_ratio
  FROM town_averages
)
SELECT
  town_city,
  average_price,
  average_ratio,
  average_ratio - cross_town_average_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM with_cross_town_average
WHERE average_ratio > cross_town_average_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with a missing town are excluded; zero total cost makes the ratio undefined and is ignored by AVG.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat missing town as its own group instead of excluding it.
